datasets.name: Daily news shock panel for Asian countries (GDELT)
datasets.description: This dataset tracks day-by-day changes in news intensity for countries in Asia using the GDELT global news database. Each row represents one country on one date, making it easy to see unusual spikes or drops in media attention over time. It is a ready-to-use country-by-day panel for comparing regional news pressure patterns.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to study when and where news attention surges across Asian countries.
datasets.limitations: Derived GDELT metadata signal, not ground truth article corpus; missing months until backfill finishes.
datasets.display_name: Daily news shock panel for Asian countries (GDELT)
datasets.one_line: Daily country-level Asia news-shock scores from GDELT GKG for event studies and macro-news controls.
datasets.title: Daily news shock panel for Asian countries (GDELT)
aliases: Daily news shock panel for Asian countries (GDELT)
datasets.meaning_about: This is a country-day panel built from the GDELT news graph focused on Asia. In plain terms, it captures how strongly each Asian country is showing up in news coverage each day, often used as a proxy for information shocks, media salience, or event pressure. Also described as an Asia news intensity panel, country-level daily media shock series, or GDELT-based news attention index.

datasets.name: GDELT High-Priority News URLs
datasets.description: This dataset is an index of news article links flagged as high priority in the GDELT global news stream. Each record represents a specific news URL tied to a detected news event. It is built for quickly finding important or fast-moving stories across worldwide media coverage.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to monitor and triage high-impact news links for analysis or alerting.
datasets.limitations: Sample/index layer, not full article text coverage.
datasets.one_line: Ranked high-priority market-relevant article URLs from the GDELT scorer, used for source review and quality checks.
datasets.title: GDELT High-Priority News URLs
datasets.meaning_about: A curated pointer layer over GDELT event-linked news links, intended to surface the most important article URLs first. Useful as an entry point for downstream enrichment, topic tracking, breaking-news monitoring, and retrieval workflows where models or analysts need direct article candidates rather than full text.

datasets.name: External Research Dataset Catalog
datasets.description: This is a curated index of research datasets collected from sources like Zenodo, OpenAlex, and other public catalogs. Each record describes a dataset so people and language models can discover what exists and where it comes from. It is a finding aid for datasets, not the underlying research data itself.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to search, browse, and link to relevant external datasets by topic or source.
datasets.limitations: Metadata only; most records are not analysis-ready until probed, queried, or downloaded.
datasets.one_line: Metadata-only seed index of external datasets to quickly discover candidate sources before procurement.
datasets.title: External Research Dataset Catalog
datasets.meaning_about: A cross-source metadata catalog of dataset records. Think of it as a library card catalog for research datasets: it helps users and models find and compare datasets across multiple repositories, then follow links to the original sources.

datasets.name: Curated External Dataset Index
datasets.description: This is a curated index of dataset records gathered from external research catalogs such as Zenodo and OpenAlex. Each row represents one dataset entry with metadata that helps people find and understand available data sources. It is built for discovery and search rather than direct statistical analysis.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to locate relevant datasets and route users or models to the right source data.
datasets.limitations: Rule-scored metadata, not semantic embeddings yet; high tier still requires human/source validation before use.
datasets.one_line: Promoted and cleaned external dataset index intended as the default search surface for users.
datasets.title: Curated External Dataset Index
datasets.meaning_about: A cross-source library of dataset metadata records (grain: one record per dataset) intended to improve dataset lookup, retrieval, and linking in research workflows. Also described as a curated external dataset catalog or dataset registry; it points to datasets and their descriptors, not the underlying measurement tables themselves.

datasets.name: Procurement Source Registry
datasets.description: A reference list of source families used to organize where procurement-related data comes from. It groups and names sources from places like Zenodo, OpenAlex, and other external catalogs so teams can use a shared vocabulary. This is a lookup dataset for consistent source labeling, not a transaction-level procurement record.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to standardize and map source names in procurement data pipelines.
datasets.limitations: Registry of routes, not final acquired data; each selected source still needs connector/probe/download implementation.
datasets.one_line: Curated registry of source families and acquisition routes to choose how a dataset should be collected.
datasets.title: Procurement Source Registry
datasets.meaning_about: This dataset describes source families (the kinds of upstream data sources) used in procurement-oriented workflows. Think of it as a controlled reference table for naming and grouping sources across catalogs, so analysts and models interpret source labels consistently.

datasets.name: CoinGecko crypto spot prices
datasets.description: This dataset provides near-real-time spot prices for cryptocurrencies from CoinGecko in a lightweight snapshot format. Each pull gives the latest quoted value for selected coins, typically in one or more fiat currencies like USD. It is a quick-reference price feed rather than a full historical market dataset.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to fetch current crypto prices for dashboards, alerts, and quick valuation checks.
datasets.limitations: Current snapshot endpoint only; not a substitute for cached historical CoinGecko panels.
datasets.one_line: Live simple-price API connector for quick crypto spot checks and lightweight market context.
datasets.title: CoinGecko crypto spot prices
datasets.meaning_about: A compact CoinGecko endpoint for latest coin price snapshots (often with optional market-cap, volume, and 24h change fields when requested), commonly used when you need fast current values instead of full OHLCV history.

datasets.name: Ethereum USDT Transfer Events
datasets.description: This dataset is a record of USDT token transfers on the Ethereum blockchain. Each row represents one transfer event, showing movement of USDT between wallet addresses over time. It captures on-chain transaction activity for tracking token flows and transfer behavior.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to analyze USDT movement patterns, wallet activity, and transfer trends on Ethereum.
datasets.limitations: Historical access requires BigQuery OAuth/ADC and a billing/quota project; local sample is only a proof of the live RPC path; no exchange/entity labels yet.
datasets.one_line: Catalog of Ethereum mainnet USDT transfer events for stablecoin flow analysis and on-chain activity studies.
datasets.title: Ethereum USDT Transfer Events
datasets.meaning_about: A structured event-level ledger of Tether (USDT) transfers on Ethereum based on ERC-20 Transfer events. It is commonly used to study stablecoin circulation, large wallet movements, exchange-related flows, and temporal activity patterns.

datasets.name: SPK v1 Sepolia Runtime Snapshot
datasets.description: A point-in-time snapshot of runtime state for the SPK v1 setup on the Sepolia Ethereum test network, focused on the Ethereum/USDT market context. It captures how the system and market-related on-chain state looked at that moment so you can inspect or compare behavior across runs. This is a reference state record rather than a narrative report.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to inspect or diff Sepolia runtime state for Ethereum/USDT testing.
datasets.limitations: Testnet only; not listed on CoinGecko; refresh via scripts/onchain/sync_spk_v1_from_solarpunk.py after operator cycles.
datasets.one_line: Canonical snapshot of SPK v1 Sepolia contracts, metrics, counterparties, and index metadata for protocol-state analysis.
datasets.title: SPK v1 Sepolia Runtime Snapshot
datasets.meaning_about: This dataset is about the live state of an SPK v1 deployment on Sepolia at a specific instant, scoped to Ethereum/USDT market context (partition: markets.ethereum-usdt). It is useful as a baseline or checkpoint for debugging, reproducibility, and model understanding of testnet system state.

datasets.name: SPK v1 USDT Payment Ledger on Ethereum
datasets.description: This dataset is a transaction-level ledger of USDT payment events on the Ethereum network for the SPK v1 stream. Each row represents a single payment event that can be used to trace who paid, when, and how much. It serves as a structured record of on-chain payment activity rather than account balances or market prices.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to analyze payment flow patterns and build transparent USDT transfer histories.
datasets.limitations: Derived from Solarpunk chain indexer; Sepolia testnet only.
datasets.display_name: SPK v1 USDT Payment Ledger on Ethereum

datasets.title: SPK v1 USDT Payment Ledger on Ethereum

datasets.meaning_about: A plain-language description: this is a log of USDT payment activity on Ethereum tied to the SPK v1 stream, at one row per payment event. People may also refer to it as a payment log, transfer ledger, or on-chain payments history for USDT.

datasets.name: Cross-asset country-week research panel
datasets.description: This dataset is a weekly panel where each row represents one country in one week, with multiple indicators combined across asset classes into a single research-ready table. It is built in-house as a fused primary panel so analysts and models can work from one consistent country-week view. The file is ready to use immediately for analysis.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it as the base table for cross-country weekly modeling and signal research.
datasets.limitations: Country proxy returns, not ticker-level attribution; latest run pinned in default_run_id.
datasets.one_line: Country-week research panel combining news shocks, crypto overlays, equity indexes, macro controls, and coverage features.
datasets.title: Cross-asset country-week research panel
datasets.meaning_about: A unified country-by-week backbone dataset that brings together signals from different asset-class perspectives into one aligned panel. Also referred to as the Cross-Asset Fused Country-Week Primary Panel (dataset_id: cross_asset_fused_primary_panel).

datasets.name: Weekly Country Broadcast News-Market Panel
datasets.description: This dataset is a weekly panel that links stock tickers with country-level broadcast news context. Each row represents a ticker in a given week, so you can compare how news exposure by country lines up with market behavior over time. It is a research-ready derived table for studying cross-country media and market patterns.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to test whether country-specific broadcast news patterns relate to weekly stock moves.
datasets.limitations: Broadcast join, not named-entity attribution; large row count (~460k).
datasets.one_line: Ticker-week panel that broadcasts country-level news shocks to each ticker and joins weekly returns.
datasets.title: Weekly Country Broadcast News-Market Panel
aliases: ticker week news by country panel
datasets.meaning_about: About dataset_id ticker_week_country_broadcast_panel: a derived ticker-by-week panel combining country broadcast news signals with market-linked observations for comparative financial media analysis.

datasets.name: Weekly stock-news entity market panel
datasets.description: This dataset is a weekly panel that links each stock ticker to entities mentioned in related news and market context for that same week. Each row represents a ticker-week view enriched with entity-resolved signals so you can study how named companies, people, or organizations align with market behavior. It is prepared as a research-ready derived panel for immediate analysis.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to test weekly relationships between news-linked entities and stock moves.
datasets.limitations: Article coverage limited to local scored/normalized windows; alias matching uses v2 supplemental aliases with match tiers.
datasets.one_line: Weekly ticker panel with organization mentions resolved to tickers and merged with market returns.
datasets.title: Weekly stock-news entity market panel
datasets.meaning_about: Dataset ID: ticker_week_entity_market_panel. Think of this as a merged weekly research table where ticker-level market data is aligned with entity-level information extracted from news, making it useful for factor research, event studies, and LLM-assisted financial analysis.

datasets.name: Weekly ticker-entity panel
datasets.description: This dataset is a weekly panel that links each stock ticker to entity-level records in a long-table format. Each row represents one ticker, one week, and one entity-related measure, with missing combinations filled as zeros for consistency. It is prepared for immediate research use and supports side-by-side comparisons across tickers and time.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to run weekly cross-sectional and time-series analysis of ticker-level entity signals.
datasets.limitations: Large panel; zeros are structural absences not confirmed non-coverage.
datasets.one_line: Complete ticker-week grid with zero-filled entity mention features to support unbiased panel modeling.
datasets.title: Weekly ticker-entity panel
datasets.meaning_about: A derived in-house research panel at ticker-week grain. It organizes entity-linked features in long form so models and analysts can easily filter by ticker, week, or entity and build consistent inputs without handling sparse gaps.

datasets.name: Weekly ticker-level residual panel
datasets.description: This dataset is a weekly panel of stocks with residual values after removing broader market and common effects, leaving ticker-specific movement. Each row represents one ticker in one week, so you can follow how idiosyncratic behavior changes over time. It is a derived research table built internally for cross-sectional analysis.
datasets.recommended_use: Use it to study stock-specific signals and run weekly cross-sectional models.
datasets.limitations: Requires broadcast panel in same run directory; residual is mention-level not return residual.
datasets.one_line: Entity-resolved ticker panel with idiosyncratic excess mention features net of country-broadcast effects.
datasets.title: Weekly ticker-level residual panel
datasets.meaning_about: A ticker-week panel where the key value is the residual (the part not explained by shared factors like market or sector moves). In practice, this is often treated as stock-specific noise or signal and used for relative-value ranking, anomaly checks, and model features in equity research.
